ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.
